newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereins- und Westbank H1 op profit up.
newsitem.headline: Vereins- und Westbank H1 op profit up.

text.p: Germany's Vereins- und Westbank AG said on Wednesday operating profit in the first half of the year rose 17.9 percent to 65.8 million marks ($36.1 million) while risk provisions fell 8.4 percent to 51.5 million marks.

Net interest income also rose 3.8 percent to 286.4 million marks and net commission income increased 12.2 percent to 147.9 million marks. The bank, a unit of Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, also said it expected a satisfactory result for all of 1997.

The parent bank said on Monday it would merge with Bayerische Hypotheken & Wechsel Bank AG, creating Germany's second largest banking group and one of the largest in Europe. Vereinsbank's firstr-half results were due on Thursday morning.
